activity_summary: Alse had been out before four with wet shoes and three boughs. Mistress Ansell allowed one over the door, and no more, and no ribbon, and Alse will not bring a second. The bough will not be dressed up. You left Gib on the second volume. The loaf is a finger and a half short, at a penny, and the board is threepence. You went up to the gate with the old man already in your head.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Came in before the gate with wet shoes, and brought three boughs down to one.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Allowed one bough, refused a ribbon, and refused a wood.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Accepted the one, and went up with the old man in his head.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Stayed on the book and was not moved.

facets.activity: Stood by one bough and went up to the gate

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: One bough over the door, and no more.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: No ribbon. The parish may dress a gate.

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: I will not bring a second in.
